scientific.integrity: The dated public preprint was inspected at the model definition, conservation law, global well-posedness theorem, Theorem 3.3, and the complete proof of its long-time conclusion. The critical page containing the original exponent-dependent inequality and incidence-integrability argument was also visually inspected. The replacement estimate is proved analytically from population boundedness and the positive Neumann resolvent. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The extension assumes the same bounded-domain, positive-rate, nonnegative-data, positive-kappa global-solution setting as the source and removes only the upper relation between p and q. It does not cover p<1, supply a decay rate, or refit the Puerto Rico data.

title: Population boundedness removes the incidence-exponent restriction in a spatial influenza model
